chunks.id: nothing claimed takes the first chunk
a tail of at most tail owners joins the chunk
a live running claim covers its owners and is waited for
a dead running claim covers nothing
done claims cover and count as prepared
failed claims cover but are not prepared
claims of another plan are ignored
claims of another implementation are ignored
everything done leaves nothing open and nothing to wait for
everything claimed by a live peer is waited for
a live peer on unrelated owners is not waited for
duplicate wanted names are one owner
code point order, not UTF-16 order
a failed claim covers its owners for the retry time
a failed claim is open again after the retry time
a failed claim without a clock keeps covering
a done claim of the same content covers
an owner edited after the prefetch is open again and the others stay prepared
a done claim made without stamps does not cover stamped content
a failed claim of other content does not cover

slots.id: forced above the maximum is ignored
zero memory still gets one slot
